name: NOOP AI
subtitle: Your strap, your data, on your device.
description: An AltStore and SideStore source for NOOP AI. This source uses the phone/iPad-only IPA for reliable free-Apple-ID signing; the separate Full IPA with widgets and Apple Watch support is available on each GitHub release. Both are unsigned by design. NOOP AI has no account, cloud service, or distribution signing identity.

apps.name: NOOP AI
apps.subtitle: A local-first companion for your WHOOP strap.
apps.localizedDescription:
NOOP AI reads a WHOOP 4.0 or 5.0/MG strap you own directly over Bluetooth. Scores, history, goals, and coach memory stay on your device. The optional coach uses only the provider and API key you choose when you send a message.

This phone/iPad-only IPA is unsigned on purpose and omits widgets and the Watch app for reliable AltStore/SideStore signing with a free Apple ID. The separate Full IPA is available on GitHub releases.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NOOP connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NOOP reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NOOP writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
